title: 1620 Prairie's brick stable stands on the alley
items: The Robert Law house at 1620 Prairie now has its own stable behind it: a two-storey brick coach house 16.3 m long on the alley, its outline, storeys, brick and two window marks read off the 1911 Sanborn sheet, standing against 1616's stable as the sheet draws it. Its carriage doors, loft hatch, other windows and gable roof come from the shared coach-house kit and are reconstructed. Robinson's 1886 atlas already marks a brick stable there. The 1874 engraving of the house shows an earlier wooden stable on the same spot, so that one is not built for 1904.
